scripts.prep-icon: mkdir -p build && sips -Z 1024 src/renderer/logo.png --out build/_tmp.png >/dev/null && sips -p 1024 1024 --padColor FFFFFF build/_tmp.png --out build/icon.png >/dev/null && rm build/_tmp.png
scripts.pack:mac: pnpm prep-icon && pnpm build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 && codesign --force --deep --sign - 'release/mac-arm64/RecruitAssist Audio Companion.app' && rm -rf ~/Desktop/'RecruitAssist Audio Companion.app' && cp -R 'release/mac-arm64/RecruitAssist Audio Companion.app' ~/Desktop/

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: RecruitAssist Audio Companion captures your microphone during candidate calls for transcription and real-time assistance.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureDescription: RecruitAssist Audio Companion captures system audio (candidate side) during calls.
